from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial snapshot containing asset information."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company whose report is being parsed")
    total_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The Total Assets figure as a numeric value")
    total_assets_currency_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported value, e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period end date or range for this financial statement")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
